feature: Jalur approve alternatif /furnish/officer/approve (FurnishApprovalController + FurnishApprovalServiceImpl): approve, revive TS-PDP, kirim email owner/furnished dan SMS dengan teks custom
note: Code kedua untuk approve furnish oleh officer. UI memakai manual-review/approve-hirer dan approve-driver (useFurnishAPI.ts:210-211), tidak ada pemanggil UI untuk /furnish/officer/approve, dan tidak ditemukan mapping-nya di api-authorization.properties. Isinya berbeda dari jalur yang dipakai (mis. revive TS-PDP lewat suspension, kirim ke owner dan furnished). Tidak dipakai sebagai bukti story; perlu dikonfirmasi apakah ini sisa implementasi lama.
note_en: A second code path for officer approval of a furnish. The UI uses manual-review/approve-hirer and approve-driver (useFurnishAPI.ts:210-211), nothing in the UI calls /furnish/officer/approve, and no mapping for it was found in api-authorization.properties. Its content differs from the path in use (for example reviving TS-PDP through suspension, sending to owner and furnished person). Not used as story evidence; needs confirmation whether it is a leftover of an older implementation.

feature: Email harian ke officer berisi furnish application yang masih pending (DailyOfficerNotificationJob)
note: Job mengirim email ringkasan harian (template FURNISH_EMAIL_OFFICER_DAILY, OCMS-DF-2026-004) ke daftar officer di furnish.notification.officer.emails (application-prod.properties:118). Dalam pencarian ini hanya controller yang menyebut job tersebut; tidak ditemukan scheduler yang memanggilnya dan tidak ada properti cron furnish di cron-schedules-prod.properties. Apakah masuk story epic 41 lain (mis. routing ke dashboard) belum dicek.
note_en: The job sends a daily summary email (template FURNISH_EMAIL_OFFICER_DAILY, OCMS-DF-2026-004) to the officers listed in furnish.notification.officer.emails (application-prod.properties:118). In this search only the controller references the job; no scheduler that calls it was found and there is no furnish cron property in cron-schedules-prod.properties. Whether another epic 41 story covers it (for example routing to the dashboard) has not been checked.
